QuestInfo.name: Stop the Summoning Ritual
QuestInfo.0: Oh no! The eastern attack was just bait! While you were fighting them, enemies on the western front started summoning the main force. And if that wasn't bad enough, Magnus's forces are starting to break through in the south. Talk to\r\n#p3000000# and discuss the plan.
QuestInfo.1: It's all over if the western enemies summon the main force! Stop the ritual by #bdefeating Weakened Magician Specters#k!\n#rIf you fail the quest, you can forfeit it and start again.#k
QuestInfo.2: You wiped out the summoners just in the nick of time. Now, time to deal with the invaders on the southern line!
